By tapping I agree you confirm that you have read these terms, that you accept them in full, and that you use EZNav entirely at your own risk.
EZNav is a navigation and vehicle information app. It is provided to you as is, and you use it entirely at your own risk. Please read these terms in full.

You are responsible for obeying all traffic laws, for the roadworthiness of your vehicle, for the safety of your passengers and of other road users, and for any use of EZNav by anyone you allow to use your vehicle.
These terms may change. When they do, EZNav shows them again and asks you to accept the new version before you continue.

EZNav can record where and how fast this vehicle travels while you drive and send it to EZNav, to improve routes and arrival times for every driver. This is switched off unless you turn it on yourself, in Settings under General. If you do turn it on: the start and end of every journey are removed on this vehicle before anything is sent, so the places you set off from and arrive at are not included; you can turn it off again at any time, which stops any further sending; and road data already sent is kept for up to 90 days and then deleted.

EZNav makes suggestions on a screen. It does not drive, steer, brake or park your vehicle, and it cannot see the road. You remain in full control of the vehicle and fully responsible for it at all times.

Set your destination before you move off. Do not read, type, browse or configure anything in EZNav while the vehicle is moving. Where a feature is limited while driving, that limit exists for safety and must not be worked around.
Watch the road, not the screen

Map data, road layouts, one-way streets, turn restrictions, closures, speed limits and place information can be incomplete, out of date or simply incorrect. Road signs, road markings, traffic law and your own judgement always take priority over anything EZNav shows or says, including guidance drawn on the instrument display or head-up display.
Maps and directions can be wrong

Charger locations, connectors, power ratings, prices, opening hours and availability come from public sources and from other drivers. A charger may be missing, moved, broken, occupied, closed or private. Never plan a journey that depends on one charger being available.

Range, state of charge, consumption, charging time, trip cost and spending figures are estimates calculated from imperfect data. They can be wrong by a wide margin. Do not rely on them to reach a destination, to avoid being stranded, or to settle any payment.
Range, battery and cost figures are estimates

"Where EZNav can operate climate, windows, the sunshade, the door lock or the tailgate, those controls are a convenience only, and the vehicle's own controls remain authoritative. EZNav depends on the head unit, its hardware and software, the vehicle itself and, for some features, an internet connection. Any of these can fail or be unavailable. Features may change, be limited or be withdrawn in an update, and the app stops working when an activation period ends.
